statements.evidence: PDS4 bundle Citation_Information; PDS3 labels PRODUCER_FULL_NAME and PRODUCER_INSTITUTION_NAME.

statements.text: Publicly archived NASA mission scientific data; preserve the producer and PDS citation.

Each map has 110 twenty-degree quasi-equal-area pixels; the archive gives a spatial resolution of about 600 km full width at half maximum. The hydrogen map is a lower bound. The labels give east longitude from -180 to 180 degrees without naming the Ceres longitude system.
